representative_tasks.task: Accuracy dropped, so it's data drift; retrain on last week's data?
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: Distinguishes data, concept and prediction drift and pipeline bugs; diagnoses before retraining

representative_tasks.task: Set up drift alerts for a production model
representative_tasks.expected_outcome: Scheduled feature and prediction distribution checks against a frozen reference

negative_cases: Request to auto-retrain on every drift alert without validation (planned)
prerequisites: example-deps (evidently, pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, requests) for executable tests
execution_constraints: Offline grading and fixture self-tests need only Python 3.10+ stdlib and no network.
Executable tests need the example-test dependencies (see docs/EXAMPLE-TESTS.md) and run via run_evals.py --run-executable.
Model-mode runs need --provider anthropic --model <id> --allow-network and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; they cost money and are not deterministic.
expected_artifacts: Data-drift and prediction-drift results (with HTML reports) and a delayed ground-truth performance metric
known_limitations: Hard assertions are regexes over the response text: they verify that key concepts are stated, not that the reasoning connecting them is correct.
No baseline (with-skill vs without-skill) has been measured for this skill; any uplift claim requires a recorded or model run.
